# Moth People
## General Information
Moths' wings give them [color=lightgreen]better acceleration in zero-gravity environments[/color], though they still can't move without equipment or a nearby surface when floating out in space.
The moth digestive system [color=palevioletred]can only process cotton and fiber-based items[/color] (such as cloth, clothing, towels, and MRE wrappers), rather than any food that other species would consider edible.
Their insect blood is iron-based, and is replenished when metabolizing iron.
They take [color=lightgreen]30% less Cold damage[/color], but [color=palevioletred]20% more Heat damage[/color]. Their fluff makes them prefer a somewhat cooler temperature range than humans, and also makes them [color=palevioletred]extremely vulnerable to fire[/color].
